# EGM acceptance script (pattern cues)

## Hook
🎬 clip: clips/goldfish_tore_my_design_alpha_sfx.mov
🗣️ Before I wrote a single line of code, a team of AI goldfish tore my design apart.

## Problem
🎬 Terminal: a huge feature prompt typed in, then a wall of code scrolling by. Counter: +1,568 lines.
🗣️ Big prompt. Big pile of code.

🎬 clip: clips/php_misread_preview.mp4
🗣️ An AI that's been chatting with you for an hour shares your assumptions.

## Solution
🎬 clip: clips/egm_intro_preview.mp4
🗣️ The elephant never forgets. The goldfish remember nothing.

🎬 Three steps appear one by one: Brainstorm, Draft, Review.
🗣️ Three steps. Brainstorm. Draft. Review.

🎬 Three tools side by side: Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity.
🗣️ It works in Claude Code, Codex, and Google's Antigravity.

## Feature
🎬 A vertical reel with chunky captions on a phone. Labels: open source, video tool.
🗣️ My test case? My open-source video tool, ossclip.

🎬 Phone with captions arriving in chunks, some words big. Checklist: not word by word, in chunks, some words big.
🗣️ Not word by word. In chunks. Some words big.

🎬 Phone showing a bold caption at the start, then calm captions. Checklist: bold at the start, calm after.
🗣️ The captions in the start could be bold and big, but the rest of them needed to be calm.

## Brainstorm
🎬 Terminal: I type `/egm:egm-brainstorm`, then the "Initial Critique & Risks" section prints.
🗣️ So first of all I went into a terminal and typed /egm-egm-brainstorm.

🎬 Phone with the caption placed in the safe space around the face. Checklist: use the face box, cheaper, taken.
🗣️ The safe space around it. It was a better idea, way cheaper, and I took it.

## Review
🎬 Terminal: `/egm:egm-review`, then "Spawned 8 subagents" and the five review stages.
🗣️ Eight fresh agents. Five review stages. Zero memory of our chat.

🎬 Number each problem on screen as I say it. Problem one: cutting a word wipes the AI caption data.
🗣️ One. When you cut a word in the editor, it would wipe out all the AI caption data. Silently.

🎬 Problem two: the caption line jumps left on every word.
🗣️ Two. Words appearing one by one would make the line jump left. Every. Single. Word.

🎬 Problem three: the Urdu captions get clipped.
🗣️ Three. My Urdu captions would get clipped in the bold uppercase themes.

## Result
🎬 A small problem card: black text on the punch badge. Sticker: Ugly. Then fixed.
🗣️ Black text on the punch badge. Ugly. Fixed in one message.

🎬 Phone: the hook caption finds the safe space around the face, then the captions settle in one steady spot.
🗣️ With AI choreography on, the hook finds the safe space around your face. Then the captions settle into one steady spot.

🎬 Terminal, typed big: `ossclip produce video.mp4 --caption-theme punch --choreograph-captions`
🗣️ One flag for the theme. One flag for the AI.

## Lesson
🎬 clip: clips/dont_self_review_alpha_sfx.mov
🗣️ Don't let the AI that wrote the plan review the plan.

🎬 The tagline, big and centred: Design with an elephant. Review with a goldfish.
🗣️ Design with an elephant. Review with a goldfish.

🗣️ ossclip is open source and free. Link's in the description.
